title: BestOf2 Project Configuration Schema
description: Configuration specification for BestOf2 dual-cloud deployments (Cloudflare Pages + AWS Lambda Web Functions).

name.description: Project deployment name (defaults to package.json name or git repository name).

limits.description: FinOps quota and rate-limiting controls enforced at Cloudflare Edge Router.

maxMonthlyInvocations.description: Monthly limit of requests allowed before triggering onLimitExceeded behavior (e.g. 500000 for Free Tier, 2000000 for Pro).

onLimitExceeded.description: Action taken when maxMonthlyInvocations is breached. 'stop' returns HTTP 429 at Edge; 'payg' allows continued execution with metered billing.

rateLimitPerSec.description: Max requests per second per IP at Cloudflare Edge before throttling.

backend.description: AWS Lambda Web Function compute and runtime specifications.

memoryMB.description: Active RAM allocated to Lambda instance (in MB).

timeoutSeconds.description: Execution timeout per HTTP request in seconds.

maxConcurrency.description: Maximum concurrent requests per warm container instance (AWS Lambda Web Function limit up to 128).

maxConcurrentInstances.description: Maximum number of simultaneous active instances to avoid runaway AWS billing.

env.description: Key-value environment variables injected into the Lambda backend.

domains.description: Custom domains and DNS routing configuration.

custom.description: Custom domain attached to Cloudflare Pages (e.g., app.example.com).
